official.status_note: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research announced the places on 20 September 2026 for the 2027 intake at KINGS, for the non-employee category; the announcement states the last date for application is 26 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: KINGS states that its Global scholarship "covers the tuition and accommodation in KINGS dormitory, meals until graduation".
benefits: KINGS Global Scholarship, supported by KHNP, KEPCO, KEPCO E&C, KPS and KNF, covers tuition and accommodation in the KINGS dormitory and meals until graduation
Master's study places in two funded fields: nuclear power plant engineering, and energy policy and engineering
Single-room dormitory accommodation with a cafeteria offering a halal option, plus sports facilities
eligibility: Non-employee category applicants (the ministry's announcement restricts the places to the non-employee category)
Applications must be submitted through the Department of Missions and Cultural Relations portal at https://portal.scrd-gate.gov.iq
Applicants must satisfy the conditions published in the ministry's official requirements document for this scholarship
For the KINGS Global Scholarship: at least 6 credits completed in each semester of the previous year and at least 2.7 GPA on a 4.3 scale with no grade F
requirements: Submit through the Department of Missions and Cultural Relations electronic portal
Review the ministry's published conditions and requirements document (الشروط والمتطلبات) linked from the announcement before applying
Choose one of the two funded fields: nuclear power plant engineering, or energy policy and engineering
selection_criteria: The Department of Missions and Cultural Relations allocates the ministry's quota among eligible applicants in the non-employee category
application_method: Register and submit through the Department of Missions and Cultural Relations portal at https://portal.scrd-gate.gov.iq
Review the ministry's published conditions and requirements document before applying
official.application_route: Electronic submission through the Ministry's Missions and Cultural Relations portal
official.citizenship_residency: Iraqi applicants in the non-employee category as defined by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
official.international_eligibility: For Iraqi applicants; study takes place at KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School (KINGS) in South Korea
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Two funded fields only: nuclear power plant engineering, or energy policy and engineering
official.description: Iraq's Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, through its Department of Missions and Cultural Relations, has announced master's study places for the 2027 intake at the KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School (KINGS) in South Korea, in nuclear power plant engineering and energy policy and engineering, for the non-employee category of applicants.

not_confirmed: documents (listed only in the ministry's linked conditions PDF)
selection criteria (listed only in the ministry's linked conditions PDF)
verification.notes: The Iraqi ministry announcement was read live (20 September 2026; deadline 26 October 2026; non-employee category; two funded fields; KINGS named as the donor side) and KINGS' own scholarships page confirms the Global Scholarship covers tuition, dormitory accommodation and meals. Neither body publishes a monetary value, and the ministry's linked conditions PDF returned unparseable binary, so the document list and English requirements remain unconfirmed.

applicant_utility.summary: Two gates matter here: the Iraqi ministry's 26 October 2026 deadline for the non-employee quota, and KINGS' own Global Scholarship conditions, which require a 2.7 of 4.3 GPA with no F grade and at least six credits in every semester of the previous year. If you are a current government employee this route is closed to you by category, so settle that before investing in the file.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Iraqi graduates who are not employed by the government and want a master's in nuclear power plant engineering or energy policy and engineering in South Korea.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you fall squarely in the non-employee category before anything else
Download and read the ministry's conditions and requirements document (dated 20 September 2026) linked from the announcement
Register on the Missions and Cultural Relations portal early - the window closes 26 October 2026, barely five weeks after the announcement
Prepare degree certificates and full transcripts that map cleanly onto one of the two funded fields
Check your CGPA against the KINGS Global Scholarship conditions of 2.7 of 4.3 with no grade F
common_rejection_risks: Applying as a government employee, since the quota is restricted to the non-employee category
A GPA below 2.7 of 4.3 or any F grade, which breaks the KINGS Global Scholarship conditions
Choosing a field outside the two funded specialisms
Submitting directly to KINGS rather than through the ministry's portal, or missing the ministry's deadline while waiting on KINGS
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Neither the ministry nor KINGS publishes a stipend, flight or insurance figure, so travel to Ulsan, visa costs and personal spending should be budgeted separately.
document_audit: The document list sits in a separate ministry conditions PDF linked from the announcement, not on the announcement page itself
The two funded fields are fixed, so your prior degree must map onto one of them rather than a general engineering profile
alerts: The deadline is firm at 26 October 2026 - about five weeks after the 20 September announcement
Only one of the two funded fields can be pursued under this quota
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the ministry's Missions and Cultural Relations portal, submit within the non-employee quota before 26 October 2026, and let the department forward successful candidates to KINGS for its own admission screening.
